data_fields.name: buildup_time
data_fields.donor_constant: 5 s on cultist-site portals; 7 s admin default

best_idea: A zone door is a server-side channel: starts on use only if the player stands in range, is cancelled on range, aggro or state failure, and fires once at end time, moving the owner plus nearby companions together.
decision_why: Keep the channel shape, but target a zone id plus spawn point (not a world position), count the engine hate list (not agent targets), and fix the square aggro window. Donor has no instancing.
acceptance: A test holds use at a no-aggro door for its buildup seconds and asserts one zone change at end time; a test that steps 3.1 units away or enters an attack state asserts the channel is cleared with no zone change; a test asserts a foe at 250 units with aggro does not block the door.
